definitions.ask: Should sase-backed fix/check recipes run the full `_setup` only when the venv lacks sase?
definitions.why: The host runs `just fix` on every sase commit; only fresh checkouts should pay setup

choices.label: Probe first; a provisioned `just fix` stays offline and never rebuilds sase_core_rs
Depend on `_setup`; every fix and commit hook fetches sase-core and may rebuild
